verdict.rationale: Justworks is a payroll and HR SaaS platform, so a sandbox or test environment for API or integration work is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a sandbox, a test mode, or isolated non-production data. The docs cover only production workflows such as payroll, benefits, time off and the Xero integration, and probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
